title: Organic Intuition
materials: Woodcut, linocut & mixed media — graduation work, Gerrit Rietveld Academie (VAV)
description:
The work process is what shaped my work. Sometimes I like to just walk out of my front door and come back with things of substance. Being able to transform my surroundings into workable material makes every tiny detail around me important. It creates moments in time that can be documented, processed, and recorded for others to wonder at. Everything can be interesting, as long as you look at it long enough.

A thin painted line ran through the whole exhibition, from work to work — the metaphorical path I walked through the Netherlands.
